## Vortex branch - fluctuation operator per sector k = m - n (background gauge) [computed]

Operator: the second variation of the energy in background gauge, K = integral of |delta P|^2 + (delta Q^2 + G^2)/Omega^2, with P = (D_t + iD_phi)phi and Q = F - (Omega^2/2)(1 - |phi|^2) the Bogomolny expressions and G = div a - Omega^2 Im(phi* eta) the background-gauge condition, on the cylinder t = log tan(theta/2) with conformal factor Omega = R sech t; kinetic metric M = integral of Omega^2|eta|^2 + |a|^2. omega^2 = generalised eigenvalues of (K, M). Finite differences: sum-of-squares form on a staggered grid, h = 0.01, t in [-10, 10]. Each eigenvalue is one complex mode (two real modes). The background-gauge term lifts all pure-gauge directions, so there is no gauge zero mode left to remove; in k = 0 the lowest mode pairs the amplitude direction (eta = phi) with the global phase rotation (eta = i phi).
